text:
Leah W: New hire hitting quickstart; first API call returned text, then next calls return 402 billing_required. Anyone seen a first-call success then immediate billing error?
Omar V: Happens if activation is async. Did you click Enable API in workspace settings and wait for activation?
Leah W: I clicked Enable API, got a green toast. Added key to env and ran the Node snippet. First run printed "Welcome", next run errored with 402.
Leah W: SDK error: Error: Request failed (402) - billing.required
SDK-bot: Node SDK retries 5xx/429 once, does not retry 402. No retries for billing errors.
billing-bot: Billing check ws_leah_team: api_access=false, payment_method=unset, last_update=1764500000.
Omar V: Likely the UI toast is optimistic and the backend job to flip api_access failed/rate-limited. We'll add a pending state.
Leah W: Workaround for onboarding docs: include step to confirm "API access: enabled" in workspace settings and show the exact error message to look for.
UI-signal: Filed devex/ux ticket to show activation pending and include trace id in toast.
Omar V: Also adding quickstart healthcheck snippet so script fails loudly on 4xx instead of printing sample text once.
Leah W: After adding a payment method and re-enabling API access, quickstart now returns 200 consistently. Marking as resolved. Thanks! :tada:
